name: French
notes: Ten courses. The two CLTR foundation courses also fulfil the upper-level writing requirement.

NOT auto-enforced: at least one elective must be in literature and/or culture prior to the 20th century, and at least one in Francophone literature and/or culture. The catalog records no period or region per course.
Majors are expected to consult the French undergraduate advisor before registering.

requirementGroups.label: Foundation courses (fulfil upper-level writing)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: FOUNDATION COURSES (fulfills upper level writing): CLTR 200: Topics in Critical Thinking; CLTR 389: MLC Research Seminar

requirementGroups.label: Core courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: CORE COURSES: FREN 153: Intermediate French; FREN 200: Advanced French; FREN 202: Introduction to Literature in French; FREN 204: Contemporary French Culture

requirementGroups.label: French literature and culture electives (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: ELECTIVE COURSES: Four or more elective courses in French literature and culture including: At least one course in literature and/or culture prior to the 20th century; At least one course in Francophone literature and/or culture
